text_block_list.text:
One day――when I was unsure which reference books
to choose for work, Chairwoman Akikawa
took me to her favorite bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Found it! Trainer <username>, it's on this shelf!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This is the nutrition book I used for reference.
I'd recommend the one next to it, too. A professor doing
fieldwork in Hidaka wrote it. And besides that...
choice_data_list: (Every single one of these books is so informative...!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! Armfuls of books, I see,
Trainer <username>!

There were nearly ten books packed inside the paper bag.
It was pretty heavy…… but with this much reference material, I should be able to give <chrname> great guidance.
choice_data_list: You really know a lot about nutrition, Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The growth of our Umamusume is my greatest wish.
Therefore, study! What other choice do I have?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: For the same reason a hardworking person like you puts in effortâ

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
This scent isâ
...Mother!

Following Chairwoman Akikawa into the boutique,
I found her standing frozen
in front of the soap display.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
I-I'm so sorry! Forgive me for leaving you behind!
However――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—However, this scent...
It resembles the scent of my mother...

Chairwoman Akikawa's mother was also the previous
chairwoman of Tracen Academy. Currently, she seems
to have left the academy to travel around the world.
choice_data_list: (So the Chairwoman followed that scent here...)

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that one is an imported item all the way from North America!
It's limited quantity, but our other customers love it!

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you care to try some? We have testers available.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A trial run!? N-No, no!
I had no intention of 'testing' you!
choice_data_list: Was the scent not to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I love it!
Both this sharp, zesty scent,
and that soft, gentle aroma…… are Mother's scent.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
T-Therefore! It is premature!
It is far too early for someone like me to handle this fragrance!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A scent that can only be worn by an adult who, like Mother,
is truly magnificent and beyond reproach—!!
choice_data_list: ――You are a truly wonderful chairwoman, Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Heh...

I know no one more suited to the position of chairwoman
than Chairwoman Akikawa. Though it's only been a short time,
I've seen her hard work up close――
choice_data_list: At least that's what I think.
At least that's how I feel.

text_block_list.text:
I reach for a bar of soap displayed on the shelf.
The price is reasonable too. This might make the perfect little token of gratitude for her keeping me company today.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer <username>?
choice_data_list: Buy soap with a relaxing scent for body and mind.
Buy soap with a crisp, invigorating scent.

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Purchased~♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really all right...
For someone like me to accept this...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, of course.
I will gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Mother often wore this scent on her days off.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"I got some time off, let's go watch together!"
Mother would often say that to me and take me out to the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...And then, holding my hand, we cheered on the Umamusume with all our might.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Shouting until our voices went hoarse. Pouring our whole hearts into it.
Cheering on those girls as they ran breathless with everything they had――!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――Laughing and shedding tears together with the Umamusume.
Doing so is where our true happiness lies.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: It's Mother's scent...
choice_data_list: You truly love your mother, Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I love her dearly.
She is my beloved mother.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Trainer.
I will treasure this soap you gave me.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—That's it!
When the day comes that I see Mother again,
I'll try using this soap!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
She might tell me I've grown splendidly,
that Mother's scent finally suits me...
...She might just praise me like that.

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text: Purchased~♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I-Is it really all right...
For someone like me to accept this...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, of course.
I will gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Mother often wore this fragrance when heading off to work.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Let's create a future full of wonder."
That was my mother's favorite motto.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mother pushed forward any reform that benefited Umamusume.
She absorbed all the complaints from the conservatives herself, spending hours on end in discussions.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And everyone held hands, continuing forward.
Her profile as she did――was truly cool.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Even now, whenever I lose my way, I think back to Mother on that day――as my guiding star.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ――……Indeed, this is Mother's fragrance.
choice_data_list: You really respect your mother, Chairwoman.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I consider myself truly blessed
to have been born as her daughter.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Trainer.
I will treasure this soap you gave me.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And I shall vow to strive ever harder to become
a chairwoman truly worthy of this fragrance.
choice_data_list: Y-You don't need to be so formal.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha!
To me, that is simply how precious the scent of those memories is.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...――And draped in this fragrance.
Someday, when I meet Mother.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
—When that time comes, I shall have Mother
praise me for how respectable I have become.
